description: Check a previously started video generation job (from generate_video's polling_url or video id). If the job has completed, downloads the video, saves it to disk, and returns the absolute path.

filename_prefix.description: Short label used in the saved filename, e.g. 'hero-banner'. Sanitized to letters, digits, dashes.

output_dir.description: Directory to save into (absolute, or ~ for home). Defaults to the configured output directory.

video_id.description: Alternatively, the raw video job id.

name: check_video_status

path.description: Absolute path of the saved video, when completed

polling_url.description: Pass to check_video_status to resume waiting

status.description: completed | pending | in_progress | timeout | failed | error

title: Check Video Status
